**Summary of the Key Financial and Legal Terms of this Agreement**

This agreement outlines the terms of a loan between Yaswanth Kumar Reddy (the Borrower) and BANK (the Lender). The key financial and legal terms are as follows:

**Loan Details**

The Borrower is borrowing $10,000 from the Lender at an annual interest rate of 8%, compounded annually. The loan can be repaid in one of three ways: weekly payments (amount not specified), monthly payments of $313.36 starting on November 8, 2025, and ending on October 8, 2028, or a lump sum payment (amount not specified).

**Payment and Late Fee**

If any payment is 10 days late, the Lender shall charge a late fee of $25. Payments are applied first to any accrued interest and secondly to the principal balance.

**Security**

The loan amount is secured by property, but no description is provided. If the Borrower breaches the security provision, the Lender may declare all sums due under this Agreement immediately due and payable.

**Prepayment and Remedies**

The Borrower has the right to pay back the loan in-full or make additional payments at any time without penalty. The Lender has the right to declare the balance of the loan and the security immediately due and payable upon the occurrence of an Event of Acceleration.

**Attorneys' Fees and Subordination**

In the event of default, the Borrower agrees to pay reasonable attorneys' fees not exceeding the maximum usury rate in the State of MA. The Borrower's obligations under this Agreement are subordinated to all indebtedness of the Borrower or any unrelated third-party lender to the extent such indebtedness is outstanding on the date of this Agreement.

**Governing Law and Miscellaneous**

This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws in the State of MA. The Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the respective successors and permitted assigns of each of the parties to this Agreement.
